probes.question: Years divisible by 100 are leap years only if they are also divisible by ____.
True or false: 2100 will be a leap year.

image.alt: An open paper diary showing the week of Friday 29 February 2008 on a wooden table.

body.question: Was 1900 a leap year?
body.reveal: No. A leap day every 4 years is slightly too much, because the year is about 365.2422 days, not 365.25. That adds up to about 3 extra days every 400 years. So years divisible by 100 skip the leap day unless they are also divisible by 400: 2000 was a leap year, 1900 was not.
